explanation: All first mismatches occur on o_mosi with bit-pattern inversions, indicating a consistent byte/bit ordering defect in the MOSI datapath. The public contract mandates preservation of serial bit order and FIFO word/byte order. Candidates 002, 006, 008, 010, 012, 014, and 016 each reverse byte lanes feeding o_mosi (via r_data_reg, fifo_a_reg, fifo_b_reg, or wb_data) and directly address the observed symptom. Candidate 004 reverses bytes in the command CRC path, which also feeds the low-level SPI transmitter. Condition-gate candidates (001, 003, 005, 007, 009, 011, 013, 015, 017–040) only modify control-flow predicates and cannot correct a pure bit-order error.
